meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 这个技能读取你在本机用 screenpipe 记录的工作时间线,找出重复出现的操作模式,与已有技能比对,把没覆盖的模式写成新技能或组合配方的草稿,放到提案文件夹供审阅。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析近期工作并提议新技能时触发,例如“分析我最近4小时/一天/一周”、“看看哪些还没覆盖”等;需要本机 screenpipe 守护进程在 3030 端口运行,否则拒绝执行。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作,提议新技能。
say.note: 启动 autoskill,分析并生成提案。

say.text: 看看我这周重复做的事,哪些还没被现有技能覆盖?
say.note: 会与已有技能匹配,输出覆盖情况。

say.text: 根据我最近的工作流,起草新技能或组合配方。
say.note: 生成 SKILL.md 草稿供你审阅。

howto.what_en: This skill reads your locally recorded screenpipe timeline, detects repeated workflow patterns, matches them against existing skills, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns into a proposal folder for your review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze recent work and propose skills, e.g. 'analyze my last 4 hours/day/week' or 'what's not covered yet'. Requires the local screenpipe daemon on port 3030; refuses to run if unreachable.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose new skills.
Look at what I did this week; what's not covered by existing skills?
say_en.note: Matches against existing skills and reports gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a new skill or composition recipe from my recent workflow.
say_en.note: Creates draft SKILL.md files for review.
